BJP Leaders to Visit Uttar Pradesh Ahead of State Elections

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has begun preparations for the upcoming Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. Party president Nitin Naveen, Home Minister Amit Shah, and National General Secretary (Organisation) B.L. Santosh are scheduled to visit the state starting this week to energize the political atmosphere. The campaign is set to commence from Meerut.
